The '''MR-9 housekeeping droid''' was a model of [[Housekeeping droid/Legends|housekeeping droid]] capable of performing basic housekeeping duties. Two MR-9 units were assigned to the [[Hyperbaride/Legends|hyperbaride]] [[DSI Hyperbaride Synthesis Plant|plant]] on [[Marca/Legends|Marca]].
